r.문화권·종교: English-speaking, several Indigenous languages · mostly Christian
r.경제 체제: Mineral exports · diamonds, uranium, oil development
r.주식시장 시가총액: $2.5 billion, 18% of GDP (2024, listed domestic companies)
r.생활 물가 수준: 41% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Gold, precious metals, gems 30%, Ores 28%, Fish and seafood 12%, Refined petroleum 4%, Refined copper 4% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Transformers 68%, Inorganic chemicals 12%, Rice 7%, Machinery, computers 5% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Copper 80%, Lead 11%, Frozen fish 8% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A presidential system and a stable democracy since independence in 1990. Its first woman president took office in 2025.

t.why: A producer of uranium and diamonds that has started developing green hydrogen.
t.rel: It became independent from South Africa in 1990. It has negotiated with Germany over an apology and reparations for genocide committed under German colonial rule.
t.know: It has negotiated with Germany over an apology and reparations for genocide committed under German colonial rule.
t.etext: It sells diamonds, uranium, copper, gold and fish. Big offshore oil discoveries have it preparing to become an oil producer.
